name: kraftverk-server

scripts.//dev: device starts both radios; ble and wifi narrow it to one. Without :write the driver refuses every write.
scripts.//start: Not a dev server: no --hot, so the process does not restart under you. Both radios, and writes are ALLOWED.

//optional: noble is only reached by --driver=ble, and it is imported lazily, so the
simulator and the MQTT transport never load it. Declaring it optional lets
a container install with --omit=optional and skip four native builds
(node-gyp, usb, bluetooth-hci-socket, serialport) for a radio it cannot
have anyway. A normal `npm install` still installs it.
